fig.start.description: Fighters share an unparalleled mastery with weapons and armor, and a thorough knowledge of the skills of combat. They are well acquainted with death, both meting it out and staring it defiantly in the face.

fig.wmg1.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once.

fig.wmg2.description: While you are wearing armor, you gain a bonus to Armor Rating.

fig.secondw1.description: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

fig.actions1.description: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

bbr.headlong1.description: Charge up to 10 m and strike; builds 1 Rage on impact, 2 if you are struck during the charge. You end the charge in the middle of them.

bbr.unmake1.description: Spend all Rage on one strike: +1d6 damage per 2 Rage spent. Rage drops to 0.

bbr.blooded1.description: At 5 Rage or more, melee attacks deal +1d4 damage.

bbr.berserker1.description: Lower your guard until your next turn: Armour halved, every hit you take builds 1 extra Rage.

bbr.pastred1.description: At 10 Rage, damage dice are doubled. No retreat and no non-Rage skills while it lasts.

bbr.thickit1.description: Gain 1 Rage each turn if two or more enemies are within reach.

bbr.bitedown1.description: Spend Rage to recover 1d6 HP per 2 Rage spent. Spending to 0 releases Held Wounds.

bbr.grudge1.description: The first time each enemy hits you, gain 1 extra Rage.

bbr.dti1.description: Spend 2 Rage on an Intimidation shout: enemies in reach make a Composure check or must attack you next turn.

bbr.hw1.description: While Rage is above 0, hold back up to CON modifier × 2 damage of each hit. When Rage hits 0, everything held lands at once.

bbr.corpse.description: Consume a fallen enemy: restore 1d6 HP and gain 2 Rage. Leaves you open (foes attack with advantage until your next turn) and adds 1 fel per corpse.

bbr.ironmind.description: When a spell targets you, spend 1 Rage to gain advantage on the check against it.

bbr.unbroken.description: When Rage hits 0, make an Endurance check. On a success, held damage lands a third per turn over 3 turns instead of at once.

bbr.headlong2.description: The charge also deals 1d6 damage on impact.

bbr.redmist2.description: Rage gained above 10 is banked as +1d6 on your next hit, up to 3d6. The surge check still rolls; a failed check loses control for a turn and 1 Sanity per banked point.
